description: Reading builds lifelong reading habits: using a library catalog, exploring authors and book lists, reading and responding to different kinds of books, a how-to project, keeping up with current information, reading-related service, and careers.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: The library
requirements.summary: Touring a library, using its catalog and finding books of several types.

requirements.title: Books you enjoy
requirements.summary: A favorite book, the author’s other works and recommended book lists.

requirements.title: Reading variety
requirements.summary: Reading several kinds of books and responding to each with a review, comparison or book talk.

requirements.title: A how-to book
requirements.summary: Reading a how-to book and completing a project from it.

requirements.title: Current information
requirements.summary: Reading about the world from more than one source and discussing it.

requirements.title: Reading service
requirements.summary: A reading-related service activity, such as reading to others or volunteering at a library.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: Careers that use reading skills and researching one of them.
